speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope

The combination of syncope occurring immediately after urination, a prodrome of only ~30 seconds, the absence of palpitations or chest pain, and normal cardiac workup (ECG and Echocardiogram) strongly points to a reflex-mediated vasovagal event triggered by the Valsalva maneuver and siphon effect. This is a benign, self-limiting condition. Have you had any similar episodes in the past, particularly when standing quickly or feeling hot?
